newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares rally to end at record closing high.
newsitem.headline: German shares rally to end at record closing high.

text.p: 1508 GMT - German IBIS DAX index continued its rally over low-volume afternoon trade on Monday to end at an all-time closing high. Drugs/chemical sector the main engine behind record run, after Swiss pharma giant Roche said it was taking over German drugs group Boehringer Mannheim.
* IBIS DAX ends at record closing high of 3,669.31 points, up 47.59. Index hits all-time high of 3,676.87 points earlier.
* June DAX future at 3,680 points, up 47.
* Bayer, BASF, Hoechst surge on Roche news as speculation of further concentration in pharmaceuticals/chemicals sector continues.
